pipelines.hypothesis: Blind (q0,ω) inversion via the s100 5-step chain: ls_bracket |ω| prior -> sample_so3_pool -> survive_at_epoch isophote clouds at anchors A,B -> 2deg decimation to reps -> finite_diff_omega+shoot cross (A-rep x B-rep BVP) -> coarse-K surrogate RMSE rank -> full-500 surrogate RMSE rank -> abc-window LM polish breaks the hard-shoot trap to Band A.
Densifying the ω-direction grid (N_DIRS 200->800) + full-LC polish + multi-magnitude-start lands Band A inversions on slow tumblers without oracle injection.
A dense joint (q0,ω) grid scored by full-LC Jacobi+surrogate MSE surfaces the truth-nearest cell in a polishable top-K, as a blind pipeline.
Connecting per-epoch IA Cloud anchors via a two-point boundary-value ω-solve, then filtering the survivors, recovers (q0,ω) blind.
Free-ω LM minimisation of photometry over a forward single-wind LC window, seeded from the pair-shoot, breaks the hard-shoot trap (Band D -> Band A).
